description: Gives the changes seen to one tracked vendor MCP server's tool list in the last 1 to 30 days (default 7): tools added and removed, tools changed with the fields that changed (title, description, input or output schema, annotations), and tools now counted as able to do more than before. Each change is dated as seen between two checks, because the tracker compares one listing with the next. The answer also says how many checks were made in the period, which ones failed, and any stretch that was not watched. A change made and undone between two checks is not seen. Changed text is never quoted. A server the tracker does not follow gets a 'not covered' answer.

days.description: How many days back to look, 1 to 30. Default 7.

vendor.description: The server, by id or name, for example "huggingface" or "Microsoft Learn".

name: get_recent_changes

data_as_of.description: When the tracker data was published.

source.description: The tracker page this answer is drawn from.

title: Get recent tool changes
